name: reports
notes: Owns saved filters only; every report is a query composition over the exported interfaces of other modules and the published view inv_v_client_material_balance (client material, BR-7), summed with Decimal arithmetic. Amounts are computed by the owning modules. The main list of a report is sorted and paged on the server, its totals cover the whole filtered set, and further tables (project totals, below-reorder items, open requisitions, headcount per day, conversion, overdue follow-ups) are returned and exported whole. Exports (CSV, XLSX) carry a header block and are refused above 50,000 rows. Permission codes use underscores (project_cost) because the code format of sys_role_permissions has no hyphen. The client material report follows reports.stock.read, which the spec does not name for it.
